concepts.quote: d = i happens by itself because double is bigger
concepts.why: Correctly applies the widening rule to the assignment of an int to the double d.

concepts.quote: d = i happens by itself because double is bigger; going from 9.99 to int needs (int).
concepts.why: Relates both conversion directions to type range: int to double is automatic, double to int needs a cast.
Correctly states that a double becomes an int only through a cast, in contrast to automatic int to double.
Applies to this code the rule that a double value goes into an int only with a cast.
